entities.summary: The administrator of Lakshadweep is the constitutional and executive head of the Union Territory of Lakshadweep. He is also the Chairman of Lakshadweep Development Corporation and SPORTS. He functions ex-officio as the Inspector General of Lakshadweep Police.
